mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (missionNo, car_id, goods_id, quantity, totalWeight, totalVol, status, createTime, factory_id, route_id, need_id) VALUES (#{missionNo}, #{carId}, #{goodsId}, #{quantity}, #{totalWeight}, #{totalVol}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{factoryId}, #{routeId}, #{needId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, missionNo, car_id, goods_id, quantity, totalWeight, totalVol, status, createTime, factory_id, route_id, need_id FROM mission
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
